display_long_description:
Meet Your Reality*: Our user-friendly VR tool for tasks in engineering and planning.

Load 3D CAD models in VR at the push of a button: Whether online or offline, use virtual twins to detect errors at an early stage. Shorten development cycles by using digital prototypes instead of complex mock-ups. Save time and money, not least through remote collaboration.

- Experience your 3D CAD drawings on a 1:1 scale
- Convert common CAD export files with the associated desktop software from XR-EASY
> 3D formats: FBX, GLTF/GLB, OBJ, VRML/WRL
> Neutral standard formats such as STEP (AP203, AP214, AP242), JT and IFC
> native CAD formats from Catia, PTC Creo, DWG, Inventor, NX, Parasolid, PLMXML, Revit, Rhino/3dm, SolidEdge, SolidWorks, VDA
- Realistic interaction with objects through intuitive manual operation

Use Cases:
> Work and assembly planning incl. ergonomic studies
> Layout planning of factories
> Architectural design reviews of buildings, e.g. for shell construction and residential properties
> Interior design and room planning, e.g. of apartments, kitchens and bathrooms or offices and laboratories
> Development of products, machines and systems

Contact us online via https://xr-easy.com/contact or by e-mail to: info@xr-easy.com

*With this app, your customers, business partners and employees can take part in PCVR sessions free of charge.
